The 2000 Washington Democratic presidential primary took place on March 7, 2000, as one of 16 contests scheduled on Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Washington non-binding primary the week before. The Washington caucus was a caucus election, with the state awarding 94 delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 75 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the caucus.
Candidates
The following candidates appeared on the ballot:
*Al Gore
*Bill Bradley
*Lyndon LaRouche, Jr.
